reviews.title: Sound issue
reviews.text: Doesn’t allow me to record multiple takes,only takes the sound from the first one,nothing else.

reviews.title: Lots of glitches and issues
reviews.text: The feature of being able to listen to a track while recording is not working for me despite hours of attempts to troubleshoot.

reviews.title: hurt and confused
reviews.text: they took the 1 minute long option and made it paid. there is very little you can fit in 30 seconds and as a longtime user to this app im sad they resorted to such cheap tatics. unfortunately i will have to find a new acapella app for my hobby

reviews.title: Aggravated
reviews.text: I don’t understand how I am not able to record without headphones. I am not going to go out and purchase wired headphones for this. Bluetooth has a delay but I can’t use without headphones???? Please make this update!

reviews.title: Who the hell uses wired headphones
Stopped Working
reviews.text: Long time paid tier user and am disappointed that this just totally stopped working. “service unavailable” displays when trying to log in. This happens even after deleting and reinstalling the app.  No support contacts found on the developer’s website.

reviews.title: Latency
reviews.text: I tried to make a project using four parts. The first three parts align perfectly, but the last parts consistently gets recorded slightly behind the beat. I am using wired headphones and restarted my phone to clear the cache and it still happens so this app is effectively unusable.

reviews.title: Difficult to Cancel Subscription
reviews.text: It feels like a trap. It’s honestly a good app for making music, but trying to cancel your subscription without cancelling your profile appears impossible. I don’t support subscription traps

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: Don’t call it a free app if you have to enter payment of commit to paying after a week after download to try it out.  The free trial assumes people will forget and get billed. Very sketchy. Just charge up front.

reviews.title: It won’t let me record
reviews.text: Why won’t it let me record? I try to record and I just get an error message.

reviews.title: Very very buggy
reviews.text: This app is impossible to use. There’s issue with lag with headphones, which I expect. But when I attempt to turn off my video audio, so that I can play along with just the metronome instead, it doesn’t work, at all. It still plays the lagged voice recording which makes recording any song impossible. Really had high hopes for this. It’s a shame really.

reviews.title: UNUSABLE FOR MUSICIANS
reviews.text: Severe audio delay makes multi-track instrument recording impossible. The app introduces latency even with wired headphones. It also crashes and freezes the video. Do not use for music. The core feature (sync) is broken.
